cards.title: Hour-14 error spike drives most of the week's failures
cards.detail: At hour 14, 1460 of 9225 requests failed (15.8% error rate) versus a baseline of about 31 errors per 8899 requests (0.35%) in every other hour; this single hour accounts for 1460 of the week's 2169 total errors (67%).

cards.title: Near-total outage at hour 3
cards.detail: Hour 3 logged only 2 requests, both of which errored, while every other hour averaged 8899 requests — consistent with a short full outage rather than a load dip.

cards.title: model-epsilon is failing on every call
cards.detail: model-epsilon shows 40 errors out of 40 requests (100% error rate) and $0 spend, indicating the model is non-functional for the whole window despite low volume.

cards.title: caller-01 concentrates over half of all traffic and spend
cards.detail: caller-01 made 105,832 of 204,993 requests (51.6%) and $1643.86 of $3354.82 spend (49.0%), far ahead of any other caller.

cards.title: Cache hit rates split into two distinct clusters
cards.detail: About half the callers cache well (e.g. caller-01 87%, caller-06 88.8%, caller-14 87.5%) while others barely cache at all (caller-07 4%, caller-21 3.7%, caller-19 and caller-22 at 0%), suggesting caching is misconfigured or disabled for the low group.

cards.title: caller-07 pays far more per request than the fleet average
cards.detail: caller-07 spent $174.12 over 1180 requests ($0.148/request), about 9x the fleet-wide average of $0.0164/request ($3354.82 over 204,993 requests).
